name: Feel Energy | 25mg Seltzer | Cotton Candy Grape
description: Meet the newest addition to the FEEL lineup: 25mg THC beverages, crafted for those looking for a stronger experience. Available in three refreshing flavors, each can delivers a smooth, uplifting way to sip, relax, and FEEL more—with low sugar and great taste. Infused with 25mg THC and 60mg of caffeine from organic green tea, it delivers a clean, balanced boost without the jitters.
